comingLast.roast: someone check the carpark - he was seen looking at his keys
on 12 at 0.9 - his playing partners are witnesses now, not opponents
at 1.2 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
6 holes to change the story - the current draft ends at the presso table
on 19 with 4 to play - Harris is quietly cheering against him
the gap is 1 - close enough that his mates ordered him a blue drink as a joke
in on a 2-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
